Welcome to HealthCare Venture

Healthcare venture is an investment consortium dedicated to acquiring and consolidating targeted youth mental healthcare acompanies in the Netherlands.

LEARN MORE

About us

Our goal in the Dutch mental youth care market is to establish a new standard of excellence, driven by client-focused growth and innovation. 

We are committed to being a benchmark in superior care, achieved through a team of dedicated, expertly trained staff who deeply understand and address our client’s true needs.

Our approach is to hire top-tier employees skilled in identifying and resolving underlying client issues, enhancing care quality while ensuring healthy profit margins. 

Our buy-and-build model aims to acquire and grow at least 5 youth mental healthcare firms, serving 1000 clients and generating €25M in revenue by 2030.

Learn more about us

Our team

With a collective experience of over 120 years in health care management, strategy, operations, finance, legal, and M&A, our team is well-equipped to navigate the challenges of the growing youth mental healthcare need.

  • VISION

Our vision is to realise the full chain in youth mental healthcare. Starting psychiatry, psychology, begeleiding, and opvang+ via buy and build strategy, and grow the company to serve 1,000 clients which will translate to €25 million in revenue by 2030.
